_comment: Generic FATES discoveries - applies to all sites
_source: Knox 2026 CNP Guidebook + A2MC calibration experience
_affects_convention: Use official FATES/ELM variable names in 'affects' (e.g., FATES_FROOTC, FATES_LEAFC_PF, LABILEP_vr). Use 'affects_pfts' (optional, 1-indexed) to specify which PFTs are impacted (e.g., [7, 10]). Omit or leave empty for all PFTs. See docs/a2mc_reference/fates_data_reference.md.

discoveries.name: ECA vs RD Mode vmax Ranges
discoveries.description: ECA and RD modes require fundamentally different vmax parameter ranges due to different source limitation functions
discoveries.mechanism: ECA has stronger source limitation, so larger vmax values (~10^-7) are needed. RD has weaker limitation, so smaller vmax (~10^-9) works.
discoveries.action: When switching between ECA and RD modes, adjust vmax by ~2 orders of magnitude

discoveries.name: RD Mode NH4/NO3 vmax Are Additive
discoveries.description: In RD mode, vmax_nh4 and vmax_no3 are added together for total N demand calculation
discoveries.mechanism: RD scheme wants a single N demand, so it adds vmax_nh4 + vmax_no3. Individual values don't matter, only their sum. ECA works independently on each.
discoveries.action: For RD mode, only tune the sum of vmax_nh4 + vmax_no3, not individual values

discoveries.name: FATES_L2FR Diagnostic Thresholds
discoveries.description: FATES_L2FR values outside 0.1-10 range indicate poor calibration or strange dynamics
discoveries.mechanism: L2FR is the target fine-root-C per leaf-C ratio (FATES fates_allom_l2fr, units gC/gC, long_name 'fine root C per leaf C'; target fineroot = leaf*L2FR, FatesAllometryMod.F90:1086). The name 'l2fr'/'leaf-to-fineroot' is misleading: HIGH L2FR = MORE fine root per leaf, low L2FR = almost no fine root. Very low (<0.1) or high (>10) values are physiologically unrealistic and signal PID instability or nutrient problems.
discoveries.action: If L2FR < 0.1 or > 10, investigate nutrient supply and consider reducing fates_cnp_pid_kp by 10×

discoveries.name: PID Kp Reduction for Stabilization
discoveries.description: Reducing fates_cnp_pid_kp by 10× can stabilize unstable L2FR dynamics during calibration
discoveries.mechanism: High Kp causes aggressive allocation adjustments that can become oscillatory or monotonically unstable. Lower Kp dampens response.
discoveries.action: If L2FR shows rapid/monotonic changes, reduce fates_cnp_pid_kp by 10×

discoveries.name: AD Spinup Must Start at Year 0001
discoveries.description: Accelerated decomposition (AD) spinup simulations must start at year 0001 or they won't work correctly
discoveries.mechanism: Carbon AD mode has internal assumptions about simulation start year. Starting at other years breaks the AD algorithm.
discoveries.action: Always set RUN_STARTDATE='0001-01-01' for AD spinup

discoveries.name: Higher Storage Parameters Promote Stability
discoveries.description: Increasing C/N/P storage parameters promotes plant stability, survivability, and adaptability
discoveries.mechanism: Larger storage pools buffer against nutrient stress and seasonal variation. Plants can draw on reserves during unfavorable periods.
discoveries.action: Increase storage parameters if plants show stress-related instability

discoveries.name: ECA KM Starting Point from Decomposers
discoveries.description: Good starting values for plant KM are same as or larger than decomposer KM values
discoveries.mechanism: Using plant KM >= decomposer KM prioritizes decomposer uptake, which keeps decomposition cycle active and mineralizes more nutrients.
discoveries.action: Start with plant KM = decomposer KM, or make plant KM larger

discoveries.name: NEFFLUX as Calibration Indicator
discoveries.description: FATES_NEFFLUX indicates N 'dumped' due to saturated stores - key diagnostic for vmax calibration
discoveries.mechanism: High NEFFLUX with low biomass/NPP means vmax is too high. Target: small NEFFLUX with reasonable biomass.
discoveries.action: Binary search vmax until NEFFLUX is small AND biomass is reasonable

discoveries.name: NEP as Spinup Equilibrium Target
discoveries.description: FATES_NEP approaching zero (decade average) indicates spinup equilibrium reached
discoveries.mechanism: NEP = NPP - heterotrophic respiration. At equilibrium with stationary climate, NEP should average to ~0 over decades.

discoveries.name: Decomposition E-Folding Depth Controls Nutrient Availability
discoveries.description: Increasing decomp_depth_efolding strengthens decomposition cycle and generates more nutrient availability
discoveries.mechanism: Deeper decomposition means more SOM decomposition, releasing more mineralized N and P. Trade-off: reduces soil C and shifts 14C profile.
discoveries.action: Increase decomp_depth_efolding (ELM parameter) if system struggles to generate nutrients

discoveries.name: Monitor Litter/SOM C:N:P Ratios for Nutrient Spiral
discoveries.description: Rising C:N or C:P ratios in litter/SOM indicate nutrient spiral that needs intervention
discoveries.mechanism: If C:N or C:P ratios increase significantly, less nutrients are mineralized per unit decomposition, creating positive feedback.
discoveries.action: Track TOTLITC/TOTLITN and TOTSOMC/TOTSOMN - if increasing, need more heterotrophic respiration

discoveries.name: Extend P Supplementation Through Regular Spinup for P-Limited Sites
discoveries.description: For strongly P-limited sites, prescribing phosphorus only during AD spinup (suplphos='ALL') may not build sufficient soil P pools. Extending suplphos='ALL' through RGSP allows the regular decomposition cycle to equilibrate with adequate P, preventing chronic P starvation during transient runs.
discoveries.mechanism: AD spinup with suplphos='ALL' builds SOM pools but the 30yr carbon-only period and accelerated decomposition may not fully equilibrate soil P. When RGSP starts with suplphos='NONE', plants must compete for mineralized P immediately. If soil P pools are insufficient, plants enter chronic P limitation from the start. Extending suplphos='ALL' through RGSP lets the regular decomposition cycle run with adequate P, building realistic labile P pools before the transient run.
discoveries.action: If diagnosis shows chronic P limitation (low LABILEP, high FATES_PDEMAND/FATES_PUPTAKE ratio, low STOREP_TF across all PFTs), recommend changing A2MC_RGSP_SUPLPHOS from 'NONE' to 'ALL' in the site config. This is a simulation protocol change, not a parameter change — it requires a full re-spinup (Phase 0 redesign). Note: this changes the soil P equilibrium state, so parameter sensitivities may shift.

_schema_note: 2026-08-25: `parameters_involved` added to this schema. Eight entries had been placing PARAMETER names in `affects`, where this file's own `_affects_convention` requires output variable names -- so `_find_relevant_discoveries()` could not match them and `_find_discoveries_by_parameters()` had no field to read. Parameter names moved to `parameters_involved` (which the manager already reads), `affects` populated with the output variables each discovery bears on, and three parameter names corrected: fates_cnp_km_{nh4,no3,p} -> fates_cnp_eca_km_{nh4,no3,p}. Provenance fields (confidence/source/discovered_by/action) untouched. Enforced going forward by tools/validate_knowledge_affects.py.
